name: Áebinn
text: Áebinn is a variant spelling of Aibell, the Munster fairy queen of oral tradition. MacKillop reads the form as a regional variant of the headword and points readers to Aibell. The principal record of that Munster fairy tradition sits under the Aibell headword.

attributes.attribute: Variant spelling of Aibell; pointer to Aibell headword

okr.objective: Áebinn is a MacKillop signpost to Aibell.
